parts.script:
A: Hey, Emma! Have you decided which art festival to attend this year?  
B: I’m thinking about the one at Riverside Park. I heard there will be live music and several workshops.  
A: That sounds awesome! Have you checked the schedule?  
B: Yes, it runs from Friday to Sunday, with exhibitions all day. I’m particularly excited about the pottery workshop.  
A: Oh, I love pottery! Is there a fee to join?  
B: There’s a small fee of twenty dollars, but it covers all materials.  
A: Perfect! Are you bringing anyone with you?  
B: I’m inviting Mark; he loves art too. What about you?  
A: I might join you guys! It would be great to spend the weekend surrounded by creativity.  
B: Definitely! Plus, there will be food stalls with local cuisine.  
A: Sounds like a plan. I will confirm with Mark and let you know!  
B: Great! Let’s make a day of it!  
A: Sure! I can’t wait to see all the local talent.  
B: Same here! It’s always inspiring to see what everyone creates.
